name: (03) Thaumaturgy (Path of the Father's Vengeance) — 2 Intermediate — Feast of Ashes

system.description:
Invoking the final curse God laid upon Caine, the thaumaturge twists a victim's hunger so that blood no longer sustains them and only ash will fill the void.

This power affects only Cainites, and you must speak the passage of the Curse aloud to your target. Make a Mental Challenge; on a win, expend a number of Mental Traits equal to the nights during which the victim gains no Blood Traits from drinking blood. Instead, for every handful of ash they consume, they gain one Ashen Blood Trait, which may only be spent to heal non-aggravated damage or to satisfy their nightly sustenance requirement. Retest with Occult.
system.duration: Number of nights equal to Mental Traits spent
